facts.text: ZeusModule is the user-facing driver class for one ZEUS module
The constructor accepts a module id in the range 1 to 31 and opens the CAN bus before initializing the Z-drive and the dosing drive
initCANBus selects the socketcan_ctypes interface on channel can0
The README initializes can_bus through an 8-devices USB2CAN interface with ./init_can.sh
sendCommand splits a command into 7-byte chunks and sends each chunk with sendDataObject
The constructor sets pos to 0, minZPosition to 0 and maxZPosition to 1800
initZDrive sets pos to maxZPosition before sending the ZI command
moveZDrive builds a GZ command with the four-digit gy position and the gw speed code, and accepts only slow or fast
pickUpTip builds a GT command with tt and go, and discardTip builds a GU command with go
aspiration builds a GA command with the five-digit ai volume, ge, go and lq table indices and the optional mixing fields
dispensing builds a GD command with the four-digit di volume, ge, go, lq and zm fields and the optional mixing fields
setEmergencyStop builds the AB command for an on state; the off branch references the undefined name seld, so this driver never sends the off command
Error code 36 means 'Emergency stop is active or was sent during action'
Error codes 53, 54 and 55 report a maximum tip volume, a maximum pipetting-drive volume and a failed volume check
